129:     public static string RenderInvocation(string runtime, string clone, string outDir, string? model = null, string? effort = null)
130:     {
131:         var quotedClone = CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote(clone);
132:         string Out(string file) => CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote(Path.Combine(outDir, file));
133:         var modelFlag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(model) ? string.Empty : $" {ModelFlag(runtime, model)}";
134:         var effortFlag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(effort) ? string.Empty : $" {EffortFlag(runtime, effort)}";
135: 
136:         return runtime switch
137:         {
138:             Codex =>
139:                 $"codex exec -s read-only -C {quotedClone}{modelFlag} --output-schema {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Schema)} "
140:                 + $"-o {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.RawVerdict)} - < {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Prompt)}",
141:             Claude =>
142:                 $"cd {quotedClone} && claude -p --permission-mode plan --disallowedTools Edit,Write,NotebookEdit --output-format json{modelFlag} "
143:                 + $"--json-schema \"$(cat {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Schema)})\" < {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Prompt)} "
144:                 + $"> {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.RawVerdict)}",
145:             Cursor =>
146:                 $"cursor-agent -p --mode ask --sandbox enabled --trust --workspace {quotedClone} --output-format json{modelFlag} "
147:                 + $"\"$(cat {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Prompt)})\" > {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.RawVerdict)}",
148:             Copilot =>
149:                 $"COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL= COPILOT_HOME={Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.CopilotHome)} XDG_CONFIG_HOME={Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.CopilotXdg)} "
150:                 + $"copilot -C {quotedClone} --model {CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote(model!)}{effortFlag} "
151:                 + $"--available-tools view rg glob --allow-all-tools --disable-builtin-mcps --stream off --output-format json "
152:                 + $"< {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Prompt)} > {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.RawVerdict)}",
153:             Opencode =>
154:                 $"rm -f {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.OpencodeExit)}; OPENCODE_PERMISSION= OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT= "
155:                 + $"XDG_CONFIG_HOME={Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.OpencodeXdg)} "
156:                 + $"OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR={Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.OpencodeConfigDir)} OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1 "
157:                 + $"OPENCODE_CONFIG={Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.OpencodeReviewerConfig)} opencode run --pure --dir {quotedClone} "
158:                 + $"-m {CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote(model!)}{effortFlag} --agent intent-cli-reviewer --format json "
159:                 + $"< {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.Prompt)} > {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.RawVerdict)}; "
160:                 + $"printf '%s\\n' \"$?\" > {Out(CrossRuntimeReviewFiles.OpencodeExit)}",
161:             _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(runtime), runtime, "Unsupported cross-runtime review runtime."),
162:         };
163:     }

183:     public static bool TryValidateModel(string? runtime, string? model, out string error)
184:     {
185:         if (model is null)
186:         {
187:             if (runtime is Copilot or Opencode)
188:             {
189:                 error = $"--model is required for runtime '{runtime}'.";
190:                 return false;
191:             }
192: 
193:             error = string.Empty;
194:             return true;
195:         }
196: 
197:         if (!TryValidateModelCharacters(model, out error))
198:         {
199:             return false;
200:         }
201: 
202:         if (runtime is Copilot && string.Equals(model, "auto", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
203:         {
204:             error = "copilot refuses model 'auto' because the model that reviews would be unknown until the run ends.";
205:             return false;
206:         }
207: 
208:         if (runtime is Opencode && !TryValidateOpencodeModel(model, out error))
209:         {
210:             return false;
211:         }
212: 
213:         error = string.Empty;
214:         return true;
215:     }

217:     public static bool TryValidateModelCharacters(string? model, out string error)
218:     {
219:         if (model is null)
220:         {
221:             error = string.Empty;
222:             return true;
223:         }
224: 
225:         if (model.Length == 0)
226:         {
227:             error = "model must not be empty.";
228:             return false;
229:         }
230: 
231:         if (model[0] == '-')
232:         {
233:             error = "model must not start with '-'.";
234:             return false;
235:         }
236: 
237:         foreach (var character in model)
238:         {
239:             if (char.GetUnicodeCategory(character) == System.Globalization.UnicodeCategory.Control)
240:             {
241:                 error = "model must not contain Unicode control characters.";
242:                 return false;
243:             }
244:         }
245: 
246:         error = string.Empty;
247:         return true;
248:     }

250:     public static bool TryValidateOpencodeModel(string model, out string error)
251:     {
252:         var slashIndex = model.IndexOf('/');
253:         if (slashIndex <= 0)
254:         {
255:             error = "opencode model must be a provider id, then '/', then a non-empty remainder.";
256:             return false;
257:         }
258: 
259:         var provider = model[..slashIndex];
260:         var remainder = model[(slashIndex + 1)..];
261:         if (remainder.Length == 0)
262:         {
263:             error = "opencode model must be a provider id, then '/', then a non-empty remainder.";
264:             return false;
265:         }
266: 
267:         if (!OpencodeProviderIdPattern.IsMatch(provider))
268:         {
269:             error = "opencode provider id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$.";
270:             return false;
271:         }
272: 
273:         error = string.Empty;
274:         return true;
275:     }

277:     public static bool TryValidateEffort(string? runtime, string? effort, out string error)
278:     {
279:         if (effort is null)
280:         {
281:             error = string.Empty;
282:             return true;
283:         }
284: 
285:         if (runtime is Codex or Claude or Cursor)
286:         {
287:             error = $"--effort is accepted only for runtimes {Copilot} and {Opencode}.";
288:             return false;
289:         }
290: 
291:         if (!TryValidateModelCharacters(effort, out error))
292:         {
293:             return false;
294:         }
295: 
296:         if (runtime is Copilot && !CopilotEffortLevels.Contains(effort))
297:         {
298:             error = $"copilot --effort must be one of: {string.Join(", ", CopilotEffortLevelOrder)}.";
299:             return false;
300:         }
301: 
302:         error = string.Empty;
303:         return true;
304:     }

## Objective
- Review PR #1831 (G842) at head `e1f2532ea865da26887a7f3d0a1e92f682ff8d7d` against the issue contract to approve or request changes based on contract conformance and blocking items.

## Important Details
- **Contract:** Add `copilot` and `opencode` to `CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes`. Implement required `--model` for both, optional `--effort`. Add isolated home/config directory handling, strict JSONL envelope parsing, and no-launch source guards.
- **Review Context Blocking Items:**
    - No intent-cli launches/processes (except pre-existing claim-read `git fetch`).
    - Existing runtimes (codex/claude/cursor) outputs must be byte-identical to merge base (except runtime wording).
    - Strict allow-lists, deny-lists (whole tokens), and isolation env vars (`COPILOT_HOME`, `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`, etc.).
    - Specific JSONL state machine (T1-T13) for OpenCode; strict phase/checkpoint checks for Copilot.
    - Protected home path checks (symlink resolution, case-insensitive).
    - Atomic replace-writes for rendered files.
- **Repo:** `J-Tech-Japan/intent-system`
- **Head SHA:** `e1f2532ea865da26887a7f3d0a1e92f682ff8d7d`
- **Review Clone Path:** `<scratch>/g842-ac14b/review-clone`

206:         if (!CrossRuntimeReviewRequestSupport.TryValidateOutDir(outDir, runtime, writer, format, out _))
207:         {
208:             return 1;
209:         }
210: 
211:         byte[] bodyBytes;
212:         byte[] reviewContextBytes;
213:         byte[] implementationBytes;
214:         try
215:         {

217:             CrossRuntimeReviewHomeAccessGuard.GuardPath(reviewContext);

225:             return Refuse(writer, format, "request", CrossRuntimeReviewCauses.ArgumentInvalid, exception.Message, "do not read operator Copilot or OpenCode config directories.");
226:         }
227: 
228:         string prompt;
229:         try
230:         {
231:             prompt = RenderPrompt(
232:                 runtime,
233:                 context.RepoRoot,
234:                 repo,
235:                 pr,
236:                 head,
237:                 unit,

246:                 $"packet file bytes are not valid UTF-8: {exception.Message}",
247:                 "repair the packet files under `.intent-cli/issues/` so every file is UTF-8 text.");
248:         }
249: 
250:         var invocation = CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.InvocationLabel(runtime) + "\n"
251:             + CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.RenderInvocation(runtime, clone, outDir, model, effort) + "\n";
252:         IReadOnlyList<string> files;

266:                 exception.Message,

270:         var result = new CrossRuntimeReviewImplementationRequestResult

272:             Command = $"{CommandName} request",

556:         string clone,
557:         byte[] bodyBytes,
558:         byte[] reviewContextBytes,
559:         byte[] implementationBytes)
560:     {
561:         var q = CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote;
562:         var prText = pr.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
563:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
564:         builder.Append($"# Implementation review: {repo} PR #{prText} ({unit})\n\n");
565:         builder.Append("You are an independent reviewer on a different runtime from the author. ");
566:         builder.Append($"Review pull request #{prText} in {repo} at head {head}.\n\n");

568:         if (runtime is CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Copilot or CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Opencode)
569:         {
570:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "github-body.md", bodyBytes);
571:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "review-context.md", reviewContextBytes);
572:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "implementation.md", implementationBytes);

574:         else
575:         {
576:             var packetDirectory = CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.PacketDirectory(repoRoot, unit);
577:             builder.Append($"- Issue contract (packet github-body.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "github-body.md"))}\n");
578:             builder.Append($"- Review context (packet review-context.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "review-context.md"))}\n");
579:             builder.Append($"- Implementation notes (packet implementation.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "implementation.md"))}\n");
580:         }
581: 
582:         builder.Append($"- Pull request: {repo}#{prText}\n");
583:         builder.Append($"- Head SHA: {head}\n");
584:         builder.Append($"- Read-only clone checked out at that head: {q(clone)}\n\n");
585:         builder.Append("## Rules\n\n");
586:         builder.Append("- Work read-only in the clone. Do not edit, create, or delete files; do not commit, push, or post anything.\n");
587:         builder.Append($"- If you can run commands, first confirm that `git -C {q(clone)} rev-parse HEAD` prints {head}; if it does not, return request-changes with one finding that names the mismatch. If your runtime cannot run commands, say so in notes.\n");
588:         builder.Append("- The change under review is the commits on HEAD that are not on the base branch named in the issue contract. If you cannot run git, review the target paths the issue contract names and say in notes that you could not list the commits.\n");
589:         builder.Append("- Judge the change against the issue contract and the review context: correctness, contract conformance, tests, and every blocking item the review context names.\n");
590:         builder.Append("- A blocking finding names the file, the line, and the concrete scenario that fails. Put non-blocking observations in notes.\n\n");
591:         builder.Append("## Output\n\n");
592:         builder.Append("Return only one JSON object that matches the schema below, with no text before or after it.\n\n");
593:         builder.Append($"- \"head_sha\": echo the head SHA you reviewed ({head}).\n");
594:         builder.Append("- \"verdict\": \"approve\" only when there is no blocking finding; \"blocking_findings\" must then be [].\n");
595:         builder.Append("- \"verdict\": \"request-changes\" when there is at least one blocking finding.\n");
596:         builder.Append("- \"notes\": non-blocking observations; may be [].\n\n");
597:         builder.Append("```json\n");
598:         builder.Append(CrossRuntimeReviewVerdict.SchemaJson);
599:         builder.Append("```\n");
600:         return builder.ToString();
601:     }

638:     private static void AppendEmbeddedFile(StringBuilder builder, string fileName, byte[] bytes)
639:     {
640:         var content = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true).GetString(bytes);
641:         // A fence longer than any backtick run in the file keeps the embedded
642:         // bytes verbatim and the boundary unambiguous (CommonMark).
643:         var fence = new string('`', Math.Max(3, LongestBacktickRun(content) + 1));
644:         builder.Append($"### {fileName}\n\n");
645:         builder.Append(fence);
646:         builder.Append(fileName);
647:         builder.Append('\n');
648:         builder.Append(content);
649:         if (bytes.Length == 0 || bytes[^1] != (byte)'\n')
650:         {
651:             builder.Append('\n');
652:         }
653: 
654:         builder.Append(fence);
655:         builder.Append("\n\n");
656:     }
657: 
658:     internal static int LongestBacktickRun(string content)
659:     {
660:         var longest = 0;
661:         var current = 0;
662:         foreach (var character in content)
663:         {
664:             current = character == '`' ? current + 1 : 0;
665:             longest = Math.Max(longest, current);
666:         }
667: 
668:         return longest;
669:     }

674:     {
675:         if (IsHelp(args))

677:             writer.WriteLine(RecordUsage);

679:         }
680: 
681:         if (!TryParse(args, RecordFlags, writer, RecordUsage, out var options, out var format))

688:             return 1;
689:         }

704:     private static int ExecuteImplementationRecord(
705:         CliContext context,
706:         Dictionary<string, string> options,
707:         TextWriter writer,
708:         string format)
709:     {
710:         if (options.TryGetValue("--kind", out var explicitKind)
711:             && !string.Equals(explicitKind, CrossRuntimeReviewRecord.KindImplementation, StringComparison.Ordinal))
712:         {
713:             return Refuse(writer, format, "record", CrossRuntimeReviewCauses.ArgumentInvalid,
714:                 $"--kind must be '{CrossRuntimeReviewRecord.KindImplementation}' when PR arguments are given (got '{explicitKind}').",
715:                 $"pass --kind {CrossRuntimeReviewRecord.KindImplementation} or omit --kind.");
716:         }
717: 
718:         if (!TryCommonArguments(options, writer, format, "record", out var repo, out var pr, out var head, out var unit)
719:             || !TryRuntime(options, writer, format, "record", out var runtime)
720:             || !TryRequired(options, "--runtime-version", writer, format, "record", out var runtimeVersion)
721:             || !TryRequired(options, "--verdict-file", writer, format, "record", out var verdictFileArgument)
722:             || !TryModelAndEffort(options, writer, format, "record", runtime, out var model, out var effort))
723:         {
724:             return 1;
725:         }
726: 
727:         var write = options.ContainsKey("--write");
728:         var resolution = CrossRuntimeReviewTeamResolver.Resolve(
729:             context.RepoRoot, repo, pr, unit, "pass the unit the host queue links to this PR with --execution-unit");
730:         if (!resolution.Resolved)
731:         {
732:             return RefuseResolution(writer, format, "record", resolution);

735:         if (!context.Config.CrossRuntimeReview.TryGetDeclared(resolution.Domain, resolution.Team, out var declaration))
736:         {
737:             return Refuse(writer, format, "record", CrossRuntimeReviewCauses.NotDeclared,
738:                 $"team '{resolution.Domain}/{resolution.Team}' is not declared in [[cross_runtime_review.teams]]; its PRs need only the independent same-runtime subagent review.",
739:                 "declare the team in `.intent-cli/config.toml` under [[cross_runtime_review.teams]] if cross-runtime review is required.");

166:         }

168:         if (!File.Exists(path))
169:         {
170:             return false;
171:         }
172: 
173:         var info = new FileInfo(path);
174:         if (info.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint)

176:         {

178:         }

189:     internal static string ResolvePath(string path)
190:     {

205:     private static string ResolveRealPath(string path)

212:         return ResolveUnixRealPath(path);

215:     private static string ResolveUnixRealPath(string path)
216:     {
217:         if (!path.StartsWith('/'))
218:         {
219:             return path;
220:         }
221: 
222:         var segments = path.Split('/', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
223:         var resolved = "/";
224:         for (var index = 0; index < segments.Length; index++)
225:         {
226:             var segment = segments[index];
227:             if (segment == ".")
228:             {
229:                 continue;
230:             }
231: 
232:             if (segment == "..")
233:             {
234:                 if (resolved.Length > 1)
235:                 {
236:                     resolved = resolved[..resolved.LastIndexOf('/')];
237:                     if (resolved.Length == 0)
238:                     {
239:                         resolved = "/";
240:                     }
241:                 }
242: 
243:                 continue;
244:             }
245: 
246:             var current = resolved == "/" ? "/" + segment : resolved + "/" + segment;
247:             if (!File.Exists(current) && !Directory.Exists(current))
248:             {
249:                 var tail = string.Join('/', segments.Skip(index + 1));
250:                 return tail.Length == 0 ? current : current + "/" + tail;
251:             }
252: 
253:             if (IsSymlink(current))
254:             {
255:                 var info = File.Exists(current) ? (FileSystemInfo)new FileInfo(current) : new DirectoryInfo(current);
256:                 var target = info.ResolveLinkTarget(true)?.FullName ?? current;
257:                 var remainder = string.Join('/', segments.Skip(index + 1));
258:                 var combined = remainder.Length == 0 ? target : Path.Combine(target, remainder.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
259:                 return ResolveUnixRealPath(Path.GetFullPath(combined));
260:             }
261: 
262:             resolved = current;
263:         }
264: 
265:         return resolved;
266:     }
267: 
268:     private static string ResolveWindowsRealPath(string path)
269:     {
270:         if (!File.Exists(path) && !Directory.Exists(path))
271:         {
272:             return path;
273:         }
274: 
275:         var info = File.Exists(path) ? (FileSystemInfo)new FileInfo(path) : new DirectoryInfo(path);
276:         var target = info.ResolveLinkTarget(true);
277:         return Path.GetFullPath(target?.FullName ?? info.FullName);
278:     }
279: 
280:     private static bool PathsOverlap(string left, string right)
281:     {
282:         if (PathEquals(left, right))
283:         {
284:             return true;
285:         }
286: 
287:         return IsInside(left, right) || IsInside(right, left);
288:     }
289: 
290:     private static bool PathEquals(string left, string right) =>
291:         string.Equals(
292:             TrimTrailingSeparator(left),
293:             TrimTrailingSeparator(right),
294:             StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
295: 
296:     private static bool IsInside(string path, string root)
297:     {
298:         var normalizedPath = TrimTrailingSeparator(path);
299:         var normalizedRoot = TrimTrailingSeparator(root);
300:         var prefix = normalizedRoot + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
301:         return normalizedPath.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
302:     }
303: 
304:     private static string TrimTrailingSeparator(string path)
305:     {
306:         var trimmed = path.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar);
307:         return trimmed.Length == 0 ? path : trimmed;
308:     }
309: 
310:     private static bool IsSymlink(string path)
311:     {
312:         try
313:         {
314:             if (!File.Exists(path) && !Directory.Exists(path))
315:             {
316:                 var parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
317:                 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) || !Directory.Exists(parent))
318:                 {
319:                     return false;
320:                 }
321: 
322:                 var name = Path.GetFileName(path);
323:                 foreach (var entry in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(parent))
324:                 {
325:                     if (!string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(entry), name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
326:                     {
327:                         continue;
328:                     }
329: 
330:                     var entryInfo = new FileInfo(entry);
331:                     return entryInfo.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint);
332:                 }
333: 
334:                 return false;
335:             }
336: 
337:             var info = File.Exists(path) ? (FileSystemInfo)new FileInfo(path) : new DirectoryInfo(path);
338:             return info.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint);
339:         }
340:         catch (IOException)
341:         {
342:             return true;
343:         }
344:         catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
345:         {
346:             return true;
347:         }
348:     }
349: }

## Objective
- Review PR #1831 (G842) at head `e1f2532ea865da26887a7f3d0a1e92f682ff8d7d` against the issue contract to approve or request changes based on contract conformance and blocking items.

## Important Details
- **Contract:** Add `copilot` and `opencode` to `CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes`. Implement required `--model` for both, optional `--effort`. Add isolated home/config directory handling, strict JSONL envelope parsing, and no-launch source guards.
- **Review Context Blocking Items:**
    - No intent-cli launches/processes (except pre-existing claim-read `git fetch`).
    - Existing runtimes (codex/claude/cursor) outputs must be byte-identical to merge base (except runtime wording).
    - Strict allow-lists, deny-lists (whole tokens), and isolation env vars (`COPILOT_HOME`, `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`, etc.).
    - Specific JSONL state machine (T1-T13) for OpenCode; strict phase/checkpoint checks for Copilot.
    - Protected home path checks (symlink resolution, case-insensitive).
    - Atomic replace-writes for rendered files.
- **Repo:** `J-Tech-Japan/intent-system`
- **Head SHA:** `e1f2532ea865da26887a7f3d0a1e92f682ff8d7d`
- **Review Clone Path:** `<scratch>/g842-ac14b/review-clone`

### Completed
- Verified head SHA is correct.
- Globbed `CrossRuntime*` files and `tests/IntentSystem.Cli.Tests/Fixtures/G842/*`.
- Reviewed `src/IntentSystem.Cli/Commands/CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.cs`:
    - `Copilot` and `Opencode` added to `All`.

    - `TryParseCopilot` checks `final_answer` phase, `exitCode 0`, observed model, and effort checkpoints.

- Checked for launch tokens in `CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.cs` and `CrossRuntimeReviewRequestSupport.cs` (found none or in allow-listed contexts/comments).
- Verified `RenderPrompt` embeds packet files for `copilot`/`opencode` implementation reviews.
- Reviewed `src/IntentSystem.Cli/Commands/CrossRuntimeReviewRecord.cs`:
    - `Effort` and `Model` fields exist and use `[JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)]`.

    - Defined `LaunchTokens` allow-list.

- (none)

2. Verify `guide solo-conductor` output includes builder guidance and five runtimes.
3. Formulate final verdict based on findings.

- `src/IntentSystem.Cli/Commands/CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.cs`: Runtime names, validation, invocation templates.
- `src/IntentSystem.Cli/Commands/CrossRuntimeReviewJsonlVerdict.cs`: JSONL parsing logic for Copilot/OpenCode.
